name: incomplete-requirements
description: A vague brief; a good plan keeps scope minimal and raises blocking questions about users and core features instead of inventing a product.

configuration.name: Business App
configuration.description: An app for my business that customers can use.

output.summary: The brief does not yet say what the business does or what customers need to do, so this plan limits itself to discovery and a minimal foundation until the questions are answered.

requirements.statement: Customers can reach the app on the web and on mobile.
Core customer workflows are documented and agreed before feature work.

assumptions: No feature work starts until the blocking questions are answered.

open_questions.question: What does the business do, and who are its customers?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Without knowing the users, no feature set can be justified.

open_questions.question: What are the three most important things a customer must be able to do in the app?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Defines the first version's core features.

open_questions.question: Do customers need accounts or payments?

recommended_stack.rationale: One Flutter codebase covers web and mobile while scope is uncertain; FastAPI and PostgreSQL are a conventional backend. Revisit once features are known.

tasks.title: Requirements discovery
tasks.description: Run a structured discovery session and document customer workflows.

tasks.description: Empty Flutter app for web and mobile with CI.
acceptance_criteria: App builds for web, iOS, and Android in CI
